name: Flutter Entertainment
exchange: NYSE (primary listing since Jan 2024; also listed on LSE under FLTR)
description: Flutter Entertainment is the world's largest publicly traded online sports betting and iGaming operator by revenue, formed through the 2016 Paddy Power/Betfair merger and subsequent acquisitions (FanDuel, Sky Betting & Gaming, PokerStars/Stars Group, and stakes in Brazil's NSX and Italy's Snai/Sisal). It reports two segments: US (anchored by FanDuel, the #1 US sportsbook by market share, plus the TVG horse-racing brand) and International (approximately 100 markets under brands including Paddy Power, Betfair, Sky Bet, PokerStars, Sisal and NSX). Revenue is earned as net win margin on sports betting handle and iGaming/poker wagers, net of promotional value and payouts.

hq.text: Dublin (registered office) / New York (operational HQ), Ireland (incorporated); operates globally

founded.value: 2016 (Paddy Power Betfair merger; predecessor Paddy Power founded 1988, Betfair founded 2000); renamed Flutter Entertainment in 2019

employees.note: 2024 10-K/annual report disclosed 27,345 employees; 2025 figure is an approximate secondary estimate pending confirmation against the FY2025 10-K human capital section

businessLines.name: US (FanDuel + TVG)
businessLines.description: US online sportsbook (FanDuel), iGaming/casino (FanDuel Casino) and horse-racing wagering (TVG), operating under state-by-state licenses, often via market-access agreements with land-based casino partners.

businessLines.name: International
businessLines.description: Sports betting, casino, poker and lottery operations across roughly 100 international markets under multiple regional brands (Paddy Power, Betfair, Sky Bet, PokerStars, Sisal (Italy), Junglee Games (India), NSX/Betnacional (Brazil), and Snai (Italy, acquisition announced/in progress)).
